name: reviewer-research decide(insufficient) → researcher-research-plan (retry)
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack recovery rule. Fires when reviewer-research terminates with decide(action=insufficient). Spawns researcher-research-plan with the reviewer's reason; the new researcher re-enters the chain at plan and re-runs through gather/synthesize addressing the gap. Bounded by rule max_iterations=3 (informational under the per-entity rule-state caveat — each reviewer loop is a distinct entity, so the cap is not a chain-wide hard ceiling under the current rule engine). Replaces the legacy research-mode-transition/02-reviewer-rejected-retry-research.json's chain.recovery.proceed-gated retry; the recoverycounter chain-ancestry-walk machinery retires in MVP-7.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-plan
on_enter.prompt:
The reviewer-research at loop $entity.instance rejected the prior research arc with decide(action=insufficient).

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to read the reviewer's structured terminal (decision_reason naming the gaps). Then call read_loop_result on the prior researcher's loop ($entity.triple.agent.lineage.researcher) if available, to read the prior research artifact verbatim. Your job is to RE-PLAN the research arc with the reviewer's gaps addressed, not start from scratch.

Iteration 2+ — emit a revised plan per researcher-research-plan/10-plan-rules.md. Carry forward what's correct; tighten scope or extend epics only where the reviewer's reason demands. Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase. The retry property + reviewer_loop_id are stamped on this loop for downstream phases to thread back through.

metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity rule-state caveat — each reviewer loop is a new entity, so the rule's max_iterations counter resets per entity. Real chain-wide bound retires alongside recoverycounter in MVP-7; smoke-test under MVP-6 confirms whether a category-scoped recovery cap mechanism is needed at this layer.
metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/02-reviewer-rejected-retry-research.json — same recovery shape, no chain.recovery.proceed sentinel.
